cases.input: Escalation from the adjudicator: claim W-2201, repair approved, inverter part number INV-2022-B. Name the part, order it, and tell the dealer when to expect it.
Escalation from the adjudicator: claim W-2202, repair not authorised, wear item outside the warranty window. Say so and notify the dealer without ordering anything.

Escalation from the adjudicator: claim W-2203, open safety campaign on the coolant circuit. Order nothing until the campaign parts are confirmed in stock; notify the dealer that a campaign repair supersedes the goodwill path.
